analyst_view.overall: Fourth-placed Twente (24 pts, two behind PSV, best defence in the league) host bottom side Willem II, who have 3 points from 12 games, a league-high 40 goals conceded and a league-low 11 scored, and are close to equalling a 42-year-old Eredivisie record for winless games. Jurgen Streppel, back for a second spell since October, says his side will try to play out of Twente's press rather than just hit long balls, while staying compact. Willem II miss captain Justin Hoogma and Amine Lachkar (counted), and keeper Thomas Didillon is doubtful, with Delanghe expected to start. Coach John van den Brom confirmed Unnerstall, Bruns and Thorvaldsen are out (the numbers count only Bruns, but Thorvaldsen has missed five games already, so recent form reflects it); Lemkin is back in training. Referee Serdar Gozubuyuk's high card rate is already counted.

goals.text: The numbers say 4.0 goals, already lifted for Twente's 21 goals in their last six and Willem II's 21 conceded. Thorvaldsen is out for a sixth game, but Twente scored freely without him, and Willem II probably lose first-choice keeper Didillon, which pulls the other way, so I stay at 4.0.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.8 corners, already up for Twente's 46 corners in six (+6%) and down for Willem II's low output. Streppel expects to be pushed back, which is exactly the one-sided pattern those figures describe, so I stay at 10.8.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.1 cards, with Serdar Gozubuyuk's 3.9 a game (+37%) and Willem II's 12 cards in six already counted. A side defending deep for long spells picks up cards, but that is priced in and no suspensions or extra needle are reported, so I stay at 4.1.

shots.text: The numbers say 35.6 shots, already lifted strongly for Twente's 145 shots in six (+25%) and cut for Willem II's low output. Streppel wants to keep the ball more, but against the league's best defence that is unlikely to change volumes much, so I stay at 35.6.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 11.2 shots on target, already up for Twente's accuracy (+14%) and down for Willem II's (-9%). Twente's absences are ones they have played without for weeks, so I stay at 11.2.
